jobs.title: Environment Art Intern- Undergraduate
jobs.description_excerpt: Job ID: R-125850 Role Summary: Join the Art Department at Insomniac Games and gain hands-on experience creating environments and assets that help bring game worlds to life. As an Environment Art Intern, you'll collaborate with experienced artists to model, texture, surface, and place assets within game environments. You'll contribute to creating natural and architectural elements while learning how environment art supports the visual design of a game. Throughout the internship, you'll receive mentorship from senior members of the Environment art team, explore new artistic techniques and tools, and gain practical experience working within a game development studio. What You’ll Be Doing: Model natural and architectural geometry using concept art and photo reference, with a focus on creating props and supporting level artists.
